sourceRefs.locator: “Un programme architectural voulu par les Carolingiens”, first two paragraphs: the basilica as the site of the 754 ceremony and later rebuilding under Fulrad.
“The Carolingians”, opening paragraphs and notes 35–37, 46: late testimony about 751, Boniface, and papal letters recalling the anointing of Pippin and his sons in 754.
Entries 749 and 750: petition to Zacharias, elevation at Soissons, Boniface and the tonsure of Childeric. Entries 753–754: papal visit, anointing of Pippin and both sons.

summary.de: Er salbte 754 in Saint-Denis Pippin und seine beiden Söhne.
summary.en: He anointed Pippin and both of his sons at Saint-Denis in 754.
